meta.notes:
Source of truth is data/sections.csv plus data/schedules/<section-id>/.
Class / faculty / room views, conflicts, LTP and load are derived from current slots of active sections.
Subjects with contact=none (NPTEL, internship, …) stay in the mapping table and faculty grid, but are omitted from class/room slots and from faculty load.
A slot may last more than one period via the hours column (does not cross lunch).
Slot CSVs store day/period/hours/subject/type/group/room only; short names and teachers are joined from subjects.csv and offerings.csv.
To add another branch or semester: add a row in sections.csv (status=active), then schedules/<id>/slots.csv and offerings.csv.
To hide a finished semester: set status=archived — files stay for history.
To issue a new w.e.f.: python3 scripts/new_edition.py <section-id> --wef DD/MM/YYYY
